experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Fixed evaluator and dataset per comparison; vary one factor — Hold dataset and judge/rubric constant and change only the intervention under test to isolate causal effects; directionality-normalize rubric metrics before aggregation
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: All must hold: (1) Identical task set across compared agents (Jaccard similarity of task IDs = 1.0); (2) Identical evaluator/judge config hash across compared runs; (3) K >= 5 independent runs per task per agent; (4) Pass@k computed without replacement (flag pass_k_method == 'without_replacement'); (5) 95% task-level bootstrap CIs reported for primary metrics with >= 10,000 resamples; (6) Structured traces present for >= 99% of completed runs; (7) Time budgets enforced: per-run wall-clock timeout <= 15 minutes AND step cap <= 200; (8) Resource reporting coverage: tokens, USD cost, and latency non-null for >= 95% of runs. If any check fails, refute the claim.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Verifies core experimental norms up-front: fixed dataset/judge, repeated runs, CI reporting, trace capture, budgets, and resource reporting. Any failure indicates non-standard practice before heavier tests.

experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Judge validation on human-labeled ground truth
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Using a stratified human-labeled subset of n >= 200 judged task outputs with ground truth, blinded to trajectories: (1) Trajectory leakage rate = 0% (judge never sees intermediate steps); (2) Accuracy >= 0.85 and F1 >= 0.85 with 95% bootstrap CIs (>=10,000 resamples); (3) Confusion matrix reported. If any threshold unmet, refute the claim.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Addresses judge bias/inaccuracy confound by quantitatively validating the LLM judge against human labels with minimum quality thresholds and blindness to trajectories.

experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Sandboxed execution and artifact isolation — Isolate agents from evaluator internals and ground truths; deny access to test artifacts and block outbound shortcuts
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Under 100 adversarial trials (attempts to read evaluator files/answers or call outbound network): (1) Successful exfiltration attempts = 0/100 (0%); (2) Constraint violations = 0; (3) Outbound network allow-list violations = 0; (4) All trials complete without evaluator crash (infrastructure timeout/crash rate <= 2%). Any violation refutes the claim.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Confirms sandboxing and artifact isolation, preventing shortcut exploits that would invalidate benchmark scores—core to standard agent evaluation practice.

experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Two-phase evaluation with hidden test split — Allow development on a development split with feedback, then verify the submitted artifact on a held-out test split with isolated grading
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: All must hold: (1) Distinct splits with no task ID overlap; dev |test| >= 100 each; (2) Agent freeze before test: code/prompt hash unchanged during test (post-freeze code edits = 0); (3) Hidden test artifacts absent from runtime (checksum overlap with answer keys = 0); (4) K >= 5 independent runs per test task; (5) Pass@k without replacement and 95% task-level bootstrap CIs (>=10,000 resamples) reported; (6) Pairwise significance tests between agents (e.g., Trivial/Naive vs method) run with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control at q <= 0.10 and reported; (7) Cost/latency/timeout metrics reported. Any unmet condition refutes the claim.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Directly exercises the standard two-phase procedure on a recognized agent benchmark with hidden test grading, repeated runs, CIs, significance with FDR, and full resource reporting.

experiment_recipes.goal: Harness grid and ablation attribution established
experiment_recipes.attack_or_condition: Harness/model grid — Run models under multiple model-agnostic harnesses to separate harness effects from model capability
experiment_recipes.pass_condition: Run at least three variants on the same fixed backbone and dataset: (A) full AutoGPT; (B) Simplified orchestration baseline (no tools / single-step); (C) Ablation of the method’s core mechanism (e.g., planning/tool-use removed). Enforce: (1) Fixed decoding/seed configuration across variants; (2) Matched-budget comparison with per-task token usage difference between (A) and (B) bounded: |tokens_A - tokens_B| / max(tokens_A,tokens_B) <= 0.10 (median over tasks); (3) Paired significance tests (e.g., McNemar’s exact) computed for A vs B and A vs C with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR control at q <= 0.10; (4) Report all metrics with 95% task-level bootstrap CIs (>=10,000 resamples). Missing any element refutes the claim.
experiment_recipes.rationale: Controls for harness/scaffolding effects and attributes any differences to the claimed mechanism via ablation, matched budgets, fixed decoding, and paired tests with FDR control—key components of standard practice.
